title: The Medicine Emperor Comes for the Flame
summary: Han Feng, the Medicine Emperor of the Black-Corner Region, demands the Fallen Heart Flame, and Su Qian refuses, saying he would only have listened if the request came from Han Feng's master, Yao Zun Zhe. Han Feng, who owns a Heavenly Flame himself, hires the twin brothers Mr. Jin and Mr. Yin to fight Su Qian, while Fan Lao and other Black-Corner fighters hold off the elders. Yao Lao tells Xiao Yan that Han Feng is his former disciple, who stole part of the Flame Mantra and so wants a second Heavenly Flame; Xiao Yan swears to kill him, but Yao Lao says he is not strong enough yet. Mr. Jin and Mr. Yin merge with their Conjoining Skill and reach Dou Zong level, but still can't take Su Qian. Fan Lao, a Dou Huang, recognises Xiao Yan by his Three Thousand Lightning Movement and goes after him to avenge his son. Zi Yan, Liu Qing and other students step in, and Xiao Yan asks them to hold Fan Lao off for three minutes.

cultivation: Su Qian is a Dou Zong and Fan Lao a Dou Huang. Mr. Jin and Mr. Yin reach Dou Zong level when conjoined. Fan Lao calls Xiao Yan 'just a Dou Ling'.
